description: This file defines the structure and functions related to 'tree' objects in a version control system, including lookup, parsing, comparison, and reading functionalities.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Looks up a tree object in the repository by its object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parses a buffer into a tree object.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Parses a tree object gently, with optional quiet mode if missing.

methods.name: parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Macro for calling 'repo_parse_tree_gently' with the current repository context.

methods.name: int repo_parse_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * item)
methods.description: Parses a tree object given a repository context.

methods.name: parse_tree
methods.description: Macro for calling 'repo_parse_tree' with the current repository context.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Parses a tree object indirectly, following tags and commits.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compares base names of paths for sorting or matching.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compares directory entry names for sorting or matching.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Reads a tree at a specific path and depth, applying a callback function.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Reads a tree recursively, optionally using a pathspec.

ctags.name: read_tree_fn_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*read_tree_fn_t)(const struct object_id *, struct strbuf *, const char *, unsigned /
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const struct object_id *,struct strbuf *,const char *,unsigned int,void *)

ctags.name: repo_parse_tree
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int repo_parse_tree(struct repository *r, struct tree *item)$/
